The 2000 Iowa Democratic presidential caucuses occurred on February 5th, and was the state caucuses of the Delaware Democratic Party.
Campaign
Vice President Al Gore was seen as the frontrunner for the nomination. Bill Bradley who had dropped out at this time, was still seen on the ballot.
Results
Caucus results
Caucus date: February 5, 2000
National pledged delegates determined: 47 (of 57)

Al Gore won all of Delaware's 3 counties. Bill Bradley lost all the previous and rest of the primaries by large margins and Al Gore would eventually lose the general election to Governor of Texas George W. Bush.
